audios.title: A job interview
audios.instructions: Listen to the interview and choose the correct answer A, B, C or D.
audios.transcript: So, tell me about your previous experience. Well, I worked for three years at a marketing company in Madrid. I was responsible for social media campaigns. Interesting. And why did you leave? The company moved to another city and I did not want to relocate. I see. And what are you looking for in this role? I would like more responsibility and the chance to work with international clients.

questions.question: How long did the candidate work at the marketing company?
questions.explanation: The candidate says: I worked for three years.

questions.question: Why did the candidate leave the previous job?
questions.explanation: The candidate says: The company moved to another city.

questions.question: What does the candidate want in the new role?
questions.explanation: The candidate says: I would like more responsibility.
